correctness.rationale: For a five-set \(S\), \(3h(S)\le10\), so it contains at most three hyperedges and inclusion-exclusion through triples is exact. The pair-overlap identity is \(p_1+2p_2=n\); pairs sharing two vertices form a matching on the \(m=2n/3\) hyperedges, so \(p_2\le n/3\). Substitution yields the stated bound. Equality forces a doubled-edge perfect matching in the cubic dual; the remaining single edges form a second perfect matching, giving alternating even cycles. The converse construction attains equality for every \(n=3k\ge9\). The saved exact checker corroborates all 640 dual multigraphs of order six and explicit equality examples at orders 9, 12, and 15.

value.rationale: The fifth coefficient is a natural and specific invariant in the regular-hypergraph independent-set problem. The theorem gives its exact extremal value for all admissible orders n>=9 and classifies every equality structure, verifying a coefficient-wise conjecture slice for 6|n and extending the equality statement to all n divisible by three in the stated range. This is more than a routine restatement or finite census.
